newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila gets investment pledges of 150.98 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila gets investment pledges of 150.98 bln pesos.

text.p: The Philippines has generated 150.98 billion pesos worth of investment pledges in the first nine months of the year, the Department of Trade and Industry said on Wednesday.
The department did not give comparative figures.
The Board of Investments approved 97.11 billion pesos worth of project proposals during the period, which is meagre compared to its full year target of 450 billion pesos.
The Philippine Economic Zone Authority generated investment proposals worth 35.72 billion pesos, while the Clark Development Corp, 9.32 billion pesos.
The Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority, the operator of the Subic freeport area, approved 8.68 billion pesos worth of investments from both local and foreign companies.
